## 1. Prediction market

Total accumulated volume in the presidential market comes to **USD 138.28M** in the [outright-winner book](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), and the reading was confirmed at 3:31 PM BRT, with a live recheck at 4:09 PM. Lula held at **57.50% (USD 9.34M)**, unchanged, after giving up 5.00pp on August 27 across five successive readings. Flávio Bolsonaro gave up **1.20pp and stands at 35.65% (USD 9.13M)**, the largest single move on the panel in the outright-winner contract.

The effect on the distance between the two is the figure of the day: the gap went from 20.65pp to **21.85pp**, and it widened entirely on the runner-up's side. It is the inverse of the August 27 shape, when the distance narrowed on his rise, also with the leader motionless.

In the [**second-place contract for the first round**](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), which measures reaching the runoff and not winning outright, Flávio Bolsonaro made the opposite move: he **rose 0.50pp, to 85.00% (USD 0.40M)**.

Outside the top, the move belongs to Augusto Cury, on the second day of his contracts' life: he gave up 0.55pp on winning, to **3.50% (USD 2.36M)**, and rose 2.95pp in the [**third-place** one](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place), **to 26.70%**. Renan Santos did the opposite, rising to **2.90% (USD 11.73M)** and easing to 35.50% on third place, where he remains ahead. Ronaldo Caiado stands at **0.25% (USD 6.88M)** and 34.50%. The third-place contract became the most contested on the panel, with the three within 8.80pp, in a book of **USD 0.68M**.

Among the sub-markets, the [contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) remains at **3.40% (USD 84,000)**, a level it has held on 13 of the last 14 days. The PL leads the bet on the [largest Senate caucus](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), with **77.00% (USD 0.29M)**, and the 5.00% to 5.49% band leads the [annual inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) one, with **47.05% (USD 0.10M)**.

## 2. What the polling institutes recorded

No national poll was released on August 28. The most recent is still PoderData/Aya of August 27, with a technical tie in both rounds: 38% to 35% and 45% to 44%.

What exists in polling this week is Quaest's state-by-state series, covering 23 states and the Federal District: [a technical tie between the top two in the country's three largest electorates](https://news.google.?oc=5), São Paulo, Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro. In Roraima, [Flávio Bolsonaro shows 52% against 17%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNaVIyZXlZZTQ4RnEtSzI1Mi1YMmoyWTNkNTFnc1JYTHJnb1lRZkZLZHNjbExEcFNnNnk2SnpQdUpQN01DOU9PSlU2cHFEbmxHR0hFaktINkRBdG5rYkR4ZlNfcHdXWU1RYzBZRXhsMUtlRS1aenJqV0JVVlB5LW9GODM2dXUxY2NfZFRGc01VMm1PRXladmQzeHJ0a1JhSVBoOXRScTVPbXlSTW9uRWVVYm45Y0p6Zw?oc=5); in Bahia, [Lula leads 50% to 17%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOanhDUVY1T1BRZ05sLVg4T19tTTB5QlBYb002TE9tdi1QSGZneVJSby1RS01ZQmFVT0J2UGFZSEE0OUZHbjNONEtPdkFtc0NoeDl0UkRSRzlSQzdUVER3cnNIdEp4OEhabkJPMnJjSWh6X1ZITFBJX01NS3BaelZjeDNKeERWZ1FWV1VZOE9YUngweTRkNElJY0ExTWhIQlZJV0FWQkVmMWRtRF9B?oc=5); and in Goiás, [Ronaldo Caiado leads with 32%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOdW13SlROdG04dk54UFViZjItWjRPYnVvLTg2M2FOcUYwcXRGbzkwUkZyYmJNdHdDbHo2YkpsX2d3NUh2UnVaWTZxYXFvNEpzdHNmbnZ2TldQRjQxRHdtd2dsaUVnM2J2bko1N00zZFpqLUh6ZkRQYThSZXJiU2lIb3RmR3Z6WEN2UkZIeS1qOHJOM0lCSVdnbHFLZ1lBQ3dy?oc=5), against 27% for Flávio Bolsonaro and 20% for Lula.

A poll with state-level scope does not enter the panel's national table, and does enter the journalistic reading.

## 3. What the press covered

Free campaign advertising [began on August 28 on radio and television](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5), and [only four candidacies hold airtime](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQenVGYW5CZEg3WVNaT001akdJc2k3d0ptWHBuTDlzMkJiTnJ2ZS10amJSX1hFRUNmOXljUktiX0NfMFVzNDBPeGxsWlhxWWpuZjJTb0FWVzU4dlZFcF9USHlTelZNb2JxVmxRQjlONlZBYm94X0kxWHlJMTREZmFQY0xiMGZKQTBhc2JZRXhXRDkxR3U0OFpiQl9OOHBTMTNPS2ItMHZaeHIzejNvcTJmbWotQjNMTHdnU2lXZ1FtTUpHUQ?oc=5). Lula's campaign opened on the attack and [used the audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro calls Daniel Vorcaro brother](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQYWszLTBHSXl3eklmalBqWkprNFNaWm03SDBWWU8wdlk4OWNaZktWN3FiMlFHcUpGSmIwYm5XNDVGdmRzcWpvMTJIUVBtbkNmdVNtRDYyYU9FWF9uMy0wRjNEMDhUaFFkU1hSTE9sNEM0NFlhQXVJUXlDb0xLd3ItLXMtUQ?oc=5). [Ronaldo Caiado only airs on Saturday](https://veja.abril.com.br/politica/caiado-vai-explorar-trajetoria-e-seguranca-publica-em-primeiro-programa-na-tv/), a day after his opponents.

In the Banco Master case, [G1 reported at 5:27 PM that the Federal Police concluded the hearing of Daniel Vorcaro](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/08/28/daniel-vorcaro-depoe-a-pf-em-investigacao-sobre-relacao-com-servidores-do-banco-central.ghtml), on his relationship with two former Central Bank officials. It had been set for the morning, after two postponements, and as of this briefing G1 is the only source published after the act. On the same day, [Estadão reported that the United States justice system asked for detailed information from the crypto-asset firm that received USD 531 million from the bank](https://www.estadao.com.br/economia/negocios/justica-dos-eua-pede-informacoes-detalhadas-a-empresa-de-cripto-que-recebeu-quase-r-3-bi-do-master/).

At the Supreme Court, André Mendonça [gave X 24 hours to explain to the electoral court the filter that blocks the recommendation of candidate profiles](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/08/28/mendonca-da-24-horas-para-x-explicar-ao-tse-filtro-que-impede-recomendacao-de-perfis-de-candidatos.ghtml). Flávio Dino [said the judiciary's over-prominence is not desirable, but that the Supreme Court cannot stand aside](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/poder/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/08/dino-diz-que-ultraprotagonismo-do-judiciario-nao-e-desejavel-mas-que-stf-nao-pode-sair-correndo.shtml). The two are [the poles of a rift over who investigates the Lulinha and Dark Horse cases](https://news.google.?oc=5), and [Estadão reported that the president told the head of the Federal Police to make peace with the reporting justice](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Flávio Bolsonaro [was interviewed on Jornal Nacional](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPLVhTSVA0cENXSVJIajZEbGp2T3RKeGhoSUxidkUyeWhvNmg2dEtUNi1Ea1VDUGdpbU95Y3dmVjRITVc1MEJ0akV0Zkl2YkVXQmpxN3pGMmhNb3lMUDFKaWNtbl9neEQ5bVRYMmRZcVFUOWVzYWZaUTdkWW9QXzhPWUFoeXNjNHBST19OWEFwRnBSV3VwcDR4OGRTcVNsN0owQUYtTWxZbUw?oc=5), a day after Lula, and [sought to court the financial market at a dinner with some 20 bankers, where the lack of robust proposals drew distrust](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/08/28/flavio-tenta-aproximacao-com-faria-lima-em-jantar-mas-falta-de-propostas-robustas-gera-desconfianca-entre-empresarios.ghtml). And [the founder of a polling institute told the BBC that the economy, and not the Lulinha case, should decide the election](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1WRllnTmlwdER3eEJPd1NreE9FMWJrcGlYSVRvZW1iNlpvcnRRdzQ4a2gwaEY2MG96bG16X2x6TnRHel8xYUk4TEt6cEdoNDh3NWFXREJEZlJlWmlGRDFpQUhR0gFnQVVfeXFMTjVWc0NPSnNRSFlUSXRKN3J0bF95UVZnS2xZdTJqT3VPQmV5R0pYUVk0Zy1WZHZjanVJZF9pekhRLU5BbDk3RjZxT2VvVHJ4Rmg3U09OWjhDOGRzRS1xYnBmU2VsR192Zw?oc=5).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Contract × contract:** the same candidate's two books pointed in opposite directions on August 28. The outright-winner one fell 1.20pp, to 35.65%, and the second-place one for the first round rose 0.50pp, to 85.00%. The market grew less convinced that he wins and more convinced that he reaches the runoff. Anyone reading only one of the two concludes the opposite of what the other says.

> **Coincidence × cause:** the leader's advertising debuted using the runner-up's audio with the former Banco Master banker, and the runner-up's price fell on the same day. AFOS records both on the same date and does not claim one produced the other, for two verifiable reasons: a single day of advertising isolates no effect, and the contract that would most directly measure the damage rose.

> **Price × polling:** Ronaldo Caiado sits at 0.25% in the outright-winner contract, below the band the panel certifies, and at the same time PoderData of August 27 puts him in a technical tie with the leader in the runoff, 43% to 44%. Probability of winning and voting intention in a runoff measure different things, and the panel publishes both without choosing.

## In summary

1. **The gap widened on a move exclusive to the runner-up.** He gave up 1.20pp with the leader motionless, and across two consecutive days it has always been him setting the distance.

2. **No national poll came out on August 28.** Six are registered for the next seven days, three of them on August 31 alone.

3. **The most contested contract on the panel is also the smallest in money.** The third-place one holds USD 0.68M, less than 0.5% of the presidential book.
